Applicants should have a high school diploma, security-related education, and relevant certifications. A driver’s license and state security credentials are required, with opportunities for training and advancement within the team.

jobs.title: Night Shift Hospital Security Officer
jobs.description:
Prime Healthcare is seeking a Public Safety Officer for Dallas Regional Medical Center in Mesquite, TX. Night shifts from 11:30pm to 8:00am, full-time, with duties including access control, patrols, emergency response and incident documentation.

The role requires healthcare security experience or related field, a State Guard Certification, and a high school diploma. Driving history may be reviewed, and a valid license is required upon hire.
